adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered the Table 1 MIC and hemolysis matrix, worker-4 reconciled DBAASP/CAMP linked rows against the primary source, and worker-6 closes the prior framework-only rework with one preserved nonblocking database conflict.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded owner-layer repair reopened XML, extracted PDF text, OA package members, supplementary PDF/text, and linked database snapshots. The supplementary asset contains analytical/purity/chromatogram/MS material, not additional activity tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: The material packet remains complete-with-gaps because no structured supplementary activity tables exist; this is nonblocking after source review because XML Table 1 contains the activity/toxicity matrix needed for worker-2/4/6.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural files and schemas are present, but acceptance is based on source-reviewed repair and strict gate reruns, not validator success alone.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and duplicate experiment rows match primary Table 1 peptide/target/value evidence; the one CAMP aggregate experiment row is preserved as source_conflict because it lacks one-to-one peptide identity.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 rebuilt all 114 supported peptide rows from Table 1: five MIC targets plus one 150 uM hemolysis value for each of 19 peptides.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to structure-activity, hemolysis trend, and time-kill phenotype; no direct membrane-target or intracellular-target claim is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The previous open ticket is closed because source-supported activity rows, database reconciliation, and worker-6 provenance are now present; remaining cautions are nonblocking and explicit.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP:CAMPSQ24410 preserves a database aggregate row that lists multiple MIC statements without one-to-one peptide sequence identity; it is not used as primary assay evidence.
The local supplementary PDF/text was checked and contains peptide structure, mass, retention time, purity, chromatogram, and MS information, not additional activity/toxicity tables.
The paper supports activity/hemolysis/time-kill phenotypes and structure-activity trends, but no direct molecular target or membrane-permeabilization assay is promoted.
